diagnostics.message: The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_launch_template.this to :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this duplicates the existing dependency through the launch template's user-data wiring? Actually there is no attribute path from the attachment to the launch template; leave explicit ordering in place to ensure policies are attached before instances use the template.

The EKS node group can begin provisioning before its IAM role policies are attached. It references the role ARN, but that does not order creation after either policy attachment; node bootstrap and cluster operations may fail until the required permissions are available.
